items.title: Nvidia’s stock drops as board reportedly preps to oust CEO Jensen Huang
items.summary: Nvidia's stock has fallen sharply amid reports that its board is preparing to remove CEO Jensen Huang following a major scandal.

items.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
items.summary: A detailed timeline outlines the events surrounding the alleged affair between Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a suspected Chinese spy, leading to calls for his ouster.

items.title: We Keep Hearing About AI Productivity. The QA Group Chat Told a Different Story.
items.summary: Despite widespread claims of AI boosting productivity, a QA team's internal discussions reveal a more complex reality, highlighting challenges and unexpected issues.

items.title: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
items.summary: Google introduces the Gemini Decisions API, designed to provide fast, calibrated multimodal decision-making capabilities for developers.

items.title: Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI launches 'Businesses in ChatGPT,' a new offering tailored to help companies integrate and leverage ChatGPT for various business operations.

items.title: Few-Step Streaming Video Generation via Condition Shifting
items.summary: Researchers present a novel method for generating streaming video in just a few steps by effectively shifting conditions, promising more efficient video synthesis.

items.title: Who could replace Jensen Huang? A highly unscientific list of possible successors
items.summary: As speculation mounts about Jensen Huang's potential departure, TechCrunch offers a speculative list of individuals who might step in as Nvidia's next CEO.

items.title: Try Tabletop: Customizable, collaborative spaces for groups to plan, play and do more together.
items.summary: Google Labs unveils Tabletop, a new platform offering customizable and collaborative virtual spaces for groups to plan, play, and work together using AI.

items.title: JioStar’s chief architect on AI discovery at 500M-user scale
items.summary: JioStar's chief architect shares insights into the challenges and successes of implementing AI discovery systems for a massive user base of 500 million.

items.title: Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits
items.summary: A new research paper introduces Tree-Ising, a method that uses bit-level Ising edits to effectively repair and improve the performance of large language models.

items.title: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
items.summary: New research explores how agentic robots can achieve advanced manipulation tasks through 'world in-context learning,' improving their adaptability and skill acquisition.

items.title: Don't Just Trust Your Memory: Evidence-Linked Memory Reduces Memory-Induced Degradation in LLM Agents
items.summary: A study proposes using evidence-linked memory to mitigate performance degradation in LLM agents, ensuring more reliable and accurate responses by grounding information.

items.title: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
items.summary: OpenAI highlights initiatives and tools designed to empower caregivers by integrating AI solutions into their daily routines for support and efficiency.

items.title: AI Code Is Unmaintainable? So Is Ours.
items.summary: This article provocatively argues that while AI-generated code often faces criticism for being unmaintainable, human-written code frequently suffers from similar issues.

items.title: dNaViT: Discrete Codes are General-Purpose Visual Representations
items.summary: Researchers introduce dNaViT, demonstrating that discrete codes can serve as effective general-purpose visual representations, simplifying and unifying visual processing.
